newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended higher while the short end was under slight pressure.
Traders said demand strongest for government coupons, with institutionals cited as buyers.

Demand was strengthened by the Swiss franc's firm tone versus the mark. German Bunds were slightly firmer on the day, but outpaced by Swiss Confederate bond futures. The spread versus German and Swiss 10-year government paper was also relatively wide at 218 basis points at the close of trade. The Swiss March Conf contract hit a new intraday high of 122.40 just prior to the close as well.
At the same time the mark was down versus the Swiss franc to levels near 86.70 centimes, the lowest level for the German currency versus the Swiss unit since roughly mid-February.
"The Swiss franc has gotten stronger, or perhaps I should say the mark has gotten weak," said one Swiss bond trader, adding that "customers still have a need to buy" bonds.
March Comi medium-term bond up 10 at 112.75
Mar Euro Swiss francs down one at 98.27.
